meta.title: OfficeSDK
meta.description: Edit Word documents, Excel spreadsheets, and PowerPoint presentations directly in DeepSeek Harness. Open a file, change its content or formatting, and save it back to the original without opening a separate Office app. The editors currently offer 233 features across Word (81), Excel (64), and PowerPoint (88). Edit the file yourself or ask AI to revise a specific passage, cell range, or slide text box. Review each change where it was made.
